fix_specification_reasoning.diagnosis_and_repair_directions: The current specification incorrectly states that the function should print the indices of the last differing element. However, since there is exactly one differing element, the notion of "last" is misleading. The function should instead focus on finding the first (and only) differing element. The error lies in the logic that updates the indices (index1 and index2) for every differing element found, which is unnecessary because there is only one differing element.
